name: Last Child ~14th Nervous Breakdown~
source:
A guy is given a card that allow him access to the Last Child club where he can have SM fun with four girls. The girls are a bit strange, which he will find out why in 50 days.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
